zh: 典型星系（1σ 峰）能形成，星系遍地
en: typical galaxies (1σ peaks) can form; galaxies everywhere

zh: 只有稀有的 3σ 峰来得及坍缩成星系，然后 Λ 把一切冻住
en: only rare 3σ peaks collapse into galaxies in time, then Λ freezes everything

zh: |Λ| 太大：还没长出星系就回缩了
en: |Λ| too large: it recollapses before galaxies can grow

zh: Λ 太大：连 3σ 峰都没长到坍缩阈值
en: Λ too large: not even 3σ peaks reach the collapse threshold

zh: （Λ < 0：这个宇宙会在 §0§ Gyr 后大坍缩）
en: (Λ < 0: this universe will crunch in §0§ Gyr)

zh: 亮金 = 星系遍地　暗金 = 只有稀有星系　灰 = 没有星系
en: bright gold = galaxies everywhere␣␣dark gold = only rare galaxies␣␣grey = no galaxies

zh: 青 = 真空泡（里面是开放宇宙）
en: teal = vacuum bubble (an open universe inside)

zh: 解析 p(t) = §0§%；换过点之后窗口是围着一个还活着的点取的，份额必然偏高，不再和 p(t) 可比
en: analytic p(t) = §0§%; after switching points the window is centered on a point that is still alive, so the fraction is necessarily high and no longer comparable with p(t)

zh: 解析 p(t) = §0§%；单次模拟涨落大：早成核的一个大泡就能吃掉一大片
en: analytic p(t) = §0§%; a single simulation fluctuates a lot: one big bubble nucleated early can swallow a large patch

zh: 指数为正：暴胀永恒，泡永远填不满全空间§0§
en: exponent positive: inflation is eternal, the bubbles never fill all of space§0§

zh: ——窗口是固定物理大小的一小块，被填满只是你这一块到头了；窗口外空间翻了 e^{2Ht} 倍，新泡还在无穷无尽地冒
en: — the window is a small patch of fixed physical size; its filling up only means your patch is done; outside the window space has grown by e^{2Ht}, and new bubbles keep appearing without end

zh: 指数为负：泡会填满空间，暴胀终止
en: exponent negative: the bubbles will fill space and inflation ends

zh: 把这个泡（Λ = §0§）里的宇宙装进创世台 →
en: Load the universe inside this bubble (Λ = §0§) into the Forge →

zh: 被吞没后：把这个泡里的宇宙装进创世台 →
en: Once engulfed: load the universe inside this bubble into the Forge →

zh: 这里暴胀结束，一个开放宇宙开始
en: Inflation ends here and an open universe begins

en: Weinberg's rough 1987 upper bound is a few hundred times the observed value (requiring galaxies to form before z ≈ 4); galaxies everywhere, as here, needs Λ ≲ §0§×; a negative Λ makes the universe recollapse, and galaxies still form if |Λ| is not too large

en: galaxies everywhere / at least rare galaxies; bubbles in the picture: §0§ everywhere, §1§ rare, §2§ dead
